userPrompt:
Once a sprint is done, it can always be closed. Read [Sprint](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#sprint), [Auto Start](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#auto-start) and [States](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#states) first.

Today "Close sprint" only appears on Current sprint's heading once every story there has ended. A story whose task can't be found reads as Queued forever (`status` in src/planning.rs). A story that was never sent, because `send_named` skipped its empty prompt, has no task at all. Either one keeps `sprint_ended` false, so the sprint can never be closed. The spec has nothing on either case yet, so this part is new. Specify it in [Sprint](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#sprint) and then make the code match:

- A story in Current sprint whose task no longer exists counts as ended and not Done. Its row shows that its task is gone (not "Queued"), and Close sprint sends it back to the start of Next sprint, as it does with failed and cancelled stories.
- Send sprint never moves a story it didn't send into Current sprint. A story with an empty title and prompt stays in Next sprint.
- [Auto Start](.claude/reference/scope/planning/index.md#auto-start) treats a story with a missing task as it treats a failed one: the next sprint doesn't start by itself, and the switch's row says why.
- Closing still saves the sections to `order.json`, as [Project Data](.claude/reference/scope/project-data/index.md#contents) says. After a reload or restart, a finished sprint can still be closed.

- **Where missing ones go:** Close sprint sends them back to the start of Next sprint, like failed and cancelled stories, never into Done.

- `status` must return a missing-task state instead of Queued.

- `send_named` must not move skipped empty stories into Current sprint.

6:Sending the sprint moves its stories into a "Current sprint" section, above Next sprint, shown only while it holds a story, so Next sprint is empty again and stories added meanwhile go there, to be the sprint after. A story in Current sprint keeps its place, its row showing its task's status as it queues, runs, and ends, and clicking it opens its task in the Tasks tab; it can't be moved or edited there. Once every story of Current sprint has ended, the section offers "Close sprint", which moves the stories that are done into a muted, collapsed "Done" list beneath the Backlog, and those that failed, were cancelled, or stopped to the start of Next sprint, in their order, to be sent again. While a sprint is current, Send sprint is disabled, its tooltip saying a sprint is already under way.
7:Send sprint only ever moves into Current sprint the stories it actually sent. A story with nothing to send, its title and its prompt both empty, is skipped: it stays in Next sprint, where it was, and Send sprint's result says, muted, how many it skipped and why, as "1 empty story left in Next sprint". A sprint where every story is empty sends nothing and makes no Current sprint.
8:Once a sprint is done, it can always be closed. Every story of Current sprint counts as ended once its task has ended, done, failed, cancelled, or stopped, or once its task can no longer be found, as when its record was deleted, it was never recorded, or the application quit before it was. A story whose task is missing is never shown as Queued, or as anything still to come: its row reads "Task missing", muted, in the theme's warning colour, its tooltip saying its task can't be found, and it counts as ended and not Done. A story still waiting in its lane's queue, or held for review, as the paused section says, is still to come and hasn't ended. So Close sprint shows as soon as no story of Current sprint is building, compiling, running, paused, queued, or held, and never waits on a task that can't arrive.
9:Close sprint treats a story whose task is missing as it treats one that failed or was cancelled: it goes back to the start of Next sprint, with the others sent again, in their order, never into Done. Closing saves the sections, Done, Next sprint, the Backlog, and the emptied Current sprint, to `order.json` straight away, as the [ProjectData](../project-data/index.md#project-data) says, and Current sprint's state is worked out afresh from the stories' tasks whenever the plan is read, so a sprint that finished, or whose tasks went missing, before a reload or a restart can still be closed after it, as before.
Each part of Planning has the same few states, shown the same way wherever they come up, so a state is never guessed from what is missing.
- Empty: a single muted line, centred in the section, saying what is missing and what to do, as "Nothing planned. Drag stories here, or press Ctrl+N.", with no illustration
A story's status in its row is the same coloured label a task has, as the [MessageList](../prompt-mode/message-list/index.md#message-list)'s status says, Queued, Running with its spinner and time, Done, Failed, Cancelled, Paused, or, where its task can't be found, Task missing, as the sprint says, and a story not yet sent shows nothing there, so its absence means "not sent".

content.text:
A finished sprint can now always be closed, even when a story's task is missing. Nothing is compiled or tested yet: `build.rs` calls `piton compile`, which this sandbox blocks, so I only checked syntax with rustfmt. Please run `cargo test`.

- **Missing tasks:** `status` in `src/planning.rs` now returns a new "Task missing" state instead of Queued when a story's task can't be found. That state counts as ended and not Done, so `sprint_ended` lets Close sprint appear. The row reads "Task missing", muted, in the warning colour, with a tooltip saying its task can't be found. Close sprint sends these stories back to the start of Next sprint and saves `order.json` as before.
- **Never-recorded tasks:** a task marked "Not recorded" used to count as Done; it now counts as Task missing, because the spec lists "never recorded" as a missing case.
- **Not falsely missing:** a story just sent but not yet queued or named would otherwise read as missing for a moment. `PromptMode` now remembers stories on their way and reports them as Queued until their task or queued prompt appears.
- **Auto Start:** a sprint that ended with a missing task doesn't start the next one by itself, and the switch's row says "A story's task can't be found…".
- **Empty stories:** Send sprint already left empty stories in Next sprint. It now also shows a muted "1 empty story left in Next sprint" beside the heading while they're still there. If every story is empty, it sends nothing and no Current sprint appears.

I also fixed something the prompt didn't mention: a story's status only followed its first task. A Chain story read Done while its code step was still running, so Close sprint could appear too early. A story now ends only once its chain steps, added steps and steps held for review have ended.

The new test, `a_sprint_with_a_missing_task_can_be_closed`, covers the missing task, the empty story and its note, closing, and what's saved.
